runs.content: RELX PLC picked up at the previous close ($36.65) — entered on a hot August jobs report (+162K vs. +53K est.) that pushed rate-hike odds up and stocks down broadly, favouring defensive/value names; RELX's wide-moat Morningstar discount (FV $57, reconfirmed Aug 6, ~36% discount at entry) carries no negative earnings catalyst, chosen over Clorox (confirmed value trap, still falling), Ecolab (shallow discount) and Ameriprise (no longer discounted). CMCL hit T2 @ $26.32 (+51.88%), banking ~$506 on the second tranche. YUMC was exited discretionarily (−8.45%, −$84) to keep the book at 35 open positions after RELX's entry — no mechanical stop-losses or signal exits on the other 33 continuing positions; AVGO (Burry Sector Warning) is now the weakest continuing position at −7.41%. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,839 (+5.07% on $56,000).

Visa (V) picked up at the previous close ($378.40) — entered on the financials sector's breakout to fresh all-time highs (XLF), a rally explicitly framed as capital rotating away from chip/AI-hyperscaler names, reinforced by Visa's own record high, a fiscal Q3 beat (+14% revenue, +10% payments volume) and Bill Ackman's disclosed ~$1.1B stake. RIVN was exited discretionarily (−9.14%, −$91) to keep the book at 35 open positions after V's entry — no mechanical stop-losses or T1/T2 triggers on the other 33 continuing positions; CMCL closed to within $0.39 of its T2 target. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,610 (+4.75% on $55,000).
